spec: SPEC.md in the same folder; generator gen.py; reference ref.py
compare: Run the engine on each case once per chunk size in chunk_ms, splitting a chunk at every event sample and calling discontinuity(gap_samples) there. The result list must have exactly 'steps' entries. Boolean fields must match exactly ('1'/'0' per step). A numeric field must satisfy |got - expected| <= abs + rel * |expected| with the tolerance of that field. Numbers were rounded to 9 significant digits. 'display' (when present) is SPEC section 9 applied to the expected results.

cases.name: vowel_u_360
cases.description: /u/, f0 360 Hz: F1 and F2 below 2.5 f0, neither may be reported (the 2nd harmonic pole at 746 Hz is not F2)

cases.name: hnr_hold
